The '''Ahakistan Council''' was the [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] council of [[Ahakista/Legends|Ahakista]]. As the council had been part of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], many on the world were angered, leading some to form a [[Ahakistan rebels|resistance]] and also leading to a [[Ahakistan civil war|civil war]] against the council.
